fields.label: Headline
fields.name: headline
fields.instructions: Each line break starts a new line.

fields.label: Highlighted words
fields.name: headline_highlight
fields.instructions: Added after the headline with the animated mint gradient.

fields.label: Text
fields.name: text
fields.default_value: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipiscing elit Ut et massa mi. Aliquam in hendrerit urna. Pellentesque sit amet sapien fringilla.

fields.label: Chips
fields.name: chips
fields.instructions: Positioned on the 1440px design and scaled with the window. On mobile they wrap above the product UI.

sub_fields.label: Depth
sub_fields.name: depth
sub_fields.instructions: How far it drifts with the mouse.

sub_fields.label: Faint
sub_fields.name: faint
sub_fields.instructions: Starts faded, comes up on scroll.

fields.label: Product UI
fields.name: ui_type
fields.instructions: The animated dashboard builds itself (counters, charts, cursor) when it arrives in the middle of the screen.

fields.label: Show demo call to action
fields.name: demo_show
fields.instructions: Fades in over the product UI once it has finished animating.

fields.label: Highlighted word
fields.name: demo_highlight
fields.instructions: Part of the title shown in mint.

fields.label: Note
fields.name: demo_note
fields.default_value: See how Zinc runs every risk from one place

fields.label: Dashboard
fields.name: dashboard
fields.instructions: Content of the animated product dashboard. Shown when Product UI is set to Animated dashboard.

sub_fields.label: Subtitle
sub_fields.name: subtitle
sub_fields.default_value: Overview of asset inventory, checkouts, and utilisation metrics

sub_fields.label: Info line
sub_fields.name: info
sub_fields.default_value: When location is not selected — data is shown across all your subscribed locations.

sub_fields.label: KPI cards
sub_fields.name: kpis
sub_fields.instructions: Up to five cards in the top row. The numbers count up when the dashboard builds. Leave empty to use the example cards.

sub_fields.label: Donut segments
sub_fields.name: segments
sub_fields.instructions: Each segment's share of the ring comes from its amount. All segments appear in the legend. Leave empty to use the example data.

sub_fields.label: Tooltip unit
sub_fields.name: tooltip_unit
sub_fields.instructions: The cursor points at the highest value, e.g. "09 Feb · 3 checkouts".

sub_fields.label: Line chart points
sub_fields.name: points
sub_fields.instructions: Plotted left to right; the axis scales to the values. Leave empty to use the example data.

fields.label: Background shapes
fields.name: background_shapes
fields.instructions: Faint shapes that rise up behind the product UI (1440 × 496). Leave empty to use the default.

fields.label: Logos
fields.name: logos
fields.instructions: Five sit evenly across the strip; with more than five they scroll past on a loop.

sub_fields.label: Logo
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Fitted within 140 × 38 (never cropped), so trim any empty space around the logo before uploading.
